    The Illinois vs. UConn Final Four game on Saturday, April 4, 2026, tips off at
    6:09 p.m. ET and will be broadcast on TBS, TNT, and truTV. The game can be streamed live on Max (formerly HBO Max) or via live TV services like DIRECTV Stream and Sling TV. 
    TV Channel Options: 
    • TBS (Primary)
    • TNT
    • truTV 
    Streaming Options: 
    • Max (formerly HBO Max): Carries all TBS, TNT, and truTV games.
    • DIRECTV Stream: Includes the necessary sports channels.
    • Sling TV: Offers packages with TBS and TNT.
    • Hulu + Live TV: Includes all required channels. 
    The game is played in Indianapolis at Lucas Oil Stadium, with the winner advancing to the National Championship game.
